privacy_policy_section1_content: Period Tracker collects health data necessary for period tracking. This includes cycle dates, symptoms, mood logs, and physical signs. Your data is primarily stored on your device.
privacy_policy_section2_content: The collected data is only used to provide cycle predictions, health insights, and partner notification features. Your data is never shared with third parties or used for advertising.
privacy_policy_section3_content: When using the partner feature, only the data you select is shared with your partner. You can change your sharing settings or turn it off completely at any time. All shared data is end-to-end encrypted.
privacy_policy_section4_content: Industry-standard encryption methods are used to secure your data. Local storage is encrypted, and cloud synchronization is protected with end-to-end encryption.
privacy_policy_section5_content: You can export, edit, or completely delete your data at any time. When you delete your account, all your data is permanently removed. You can contact our support team for any questions.
terms_section1_content: By downloading and using the Period Tracker app, you agree to these terms of service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use the app.
terms_section2_content: Period Tracker is a health app for period tracking and partner notification. The app does not provide medical diagnosis and is not a substitute for professional health care. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical decisions.
terms_section3_content: Premium features are available via subscription. Subscriptions automatically renew. Cancellation must be made at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your App Store settings.
terms_section4_content: The app is provided 'as is'. Cycle predictions are based on statistical models and 100% accuracy is not guaranteed. Do not rely solely on this app for birth control or pregnancy planning.
